The barrels also route through glass-ui's ROOT entry when first-class granular subpaths exist.

**Mechanism.** A module boundary with no encapsulation — an alias layer that adds no prop, no style, no type and no semantic, applied inconsistently, producing three parallel idioms for one design system and selecting the wrong (root-barrel) entry of the three.

**Evidence.**

```
ComponentSliders.vue:95-96 imports Card/Slider from ../../../ui/card and ../../../ui/slider. Those files in full: `export { Card, CardHeader, … } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";` and `export { Slider } from "@mkbabb/glass-ui";`. Census: 19/19 dirs contain exactly one index.ts, ZERO .vue files; 18/19 are one glass-ui re-export line (input re-exports @mkbabb/glass-ui/forms). Import census across demo/: ui/ alias barrel = 92 sites; bare @mkbabb/glass-ui root = 37; granular @mkbabb/glass-ui/<subpath> = 68. Collision inside this component's own folder, three lines apart — ConsoleRail.vue:5-12 uses ../../../ui/tooltip AND @mkbabb/glass-ui/watercolor-dot AND /dark AND /dom. Entry-size measurement: dist/glass-ui.js = 25239 B, dist/card.js = 217 B, dist/slider.js = 71 B; dist/index.d.ts = 2913 B, card.d.ts = 35 B, slider.d.ts = 37 B. glass-ui 7.0.0 publishes 70 export keys including ./card and ./slider.
```

**Reproduction.** `for d in demo/ui/*/; do …` classification loop (pasted in report); `grep -rhoE 'from "[^"]*ui/(card|slider|…)"' demo/ | wc -l` → 92; `grep -rhoE 'from "@mkbabb/glass-ui[^"]*"' demo/ | sort | uniq -c` → 37 root + 68 granular; `ls -la node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/{glass-ui,card,slider}.js`.

**Proposed cure.** Delete demo/ui/** entirely — 19 directories, 92 import sites rewritten to the granular glass subpath (@mkbabb/glass-ui/card, @mkbabb/glass-ui/slider, …). One idiom, zero indirection, the smallest correct entry (288 B of intent instead of a 25239 B barrel). This is owner edict 4 stated plainly: there is no demo design system, there is glass-ui. BLOCKED for ComponentSliders.vue itself by the glass v8 pin; the other 90 sites are unblocked.

**Reproduction.** `timeout 240 npx tsc -p tsconfig.demo.json --noEmit --traceResolution 2>&1 | grep -B40 "Module name '@mkbabb/value.js/css' was successfully"`; `ls dist/index.d.ts dist/subpaths/` ; per-subpath `shasum -a256 dist/subpaths/$s.d.ts node_modules/@mkbabb/value.js/dist/subpaths/$s.d.ts`.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-4 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** sliderWrapperEls leaks detached DOM subtrees for the lifetime of the page. The template ref callback guards `if (el)` and so never performs the unmount delete; the map is keyed by bare channel letter, which is reused across the 17 spaces, so non-shared keys strand pointing at detached reka SliderRoot subtrees.

**Mechanism.** A manual mirror of the render tree's identity, hand-maintained by a callback that implements only half the ref contract (Vue calls it with null on unmount and the guard swallows it). The render tree already knows which channels are live; the map re-derives it and gets it wrong.

**Evidence.**

```
ComponentSliders.vue:56 — `:ref="(el: any) => { if (el) sliderWrapperEls[component] = el as HTMLElement }"`. Measured live by reading the component's own setupState: initial {"gateCount":21,"mapKeys":4,"keys":["l","a","b","alpha"],"detached":0,"liveSliders":4}; after 8 space switches {"gateCount":21,"mapKeys":9,"keys":["l","a","b","alpha","r","g","c","h","w"],"detached":5,"detachedKeys":["a","b","r","g","w"],"liveSliders":4} — 9 entries for 4 live sliders, 5 hard refs to detached DOM. Two consumers iterate the poisoned map: useSliderTouchGates.ts:53 attachSliderListeners() binds FIVE listeners per entry on every space change; useSliderAnnouncements.ts:37 apply() does a querySelector + setAttribute per entry on EVERY value edit (9 DOM queries for 4 live thumbs) and computes sliderValueText for channels absent from the current space.
```

**Reproduction.** `node scratchpad/probe6.mjs` — Playwright chromium, goto http://localhost:9000/#/, then read `document.querySelector('.sliders-console').__vueParentComponent` walking up to the instance whose setupState has sliderWrapperEls; count Object.keys and those failing document.contains(). Drive 8 space switches by setting location.hash to #/?space=<s>&color=<c> for rgb, hsv, oklch, kelvin, jzazbz, ictcp, hwb, xyz with 700ms settle.

**Proposed cure.** Delete the map. The strips are a v-for over a known list — bind a single array `useTemplateRef` (Vue 3.5's array-ref form), which Vue itself keeps in exact correspondence with the rendered rows. Zero manual bookkeeping, strand-free by construction. Both downstream consumers then iterate exactly the live strips.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-5 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** 21 glass-ui useTouchGate() instances are eagerly allocated at setup — the union of every channel key across all 17 color spaces — when at most 4 are ever live. The union-by-bare-key is also a semantic collision by construction.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-8 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** The library owns the color-space taxonomy but publishes no channel domain metadata, so the demo re-declares all 51 range literals by hand — and one constant already has two homes in two packages with no shared source.

**Mechanism.** Split ownership of one concept across a package boundary. The library validates a domain it will not publish; the consumer must re-type it to build any control. They agree today by coincidence — widen the library's kelvin guard and the demo slider silently misnormalizes with no test, no type error and no signal. The other 16 spaces have no library counterpart at all, so nothing checks them.

**Evidence.**

```
src/subpaths/color.ts (full surface read) exports SpaceId, ChannelsBySpace, 17 constructors — and NO range/unit metadata. demo/color-session/picker-color.ts:52-70 re-derives it: 17 spaces of literal min/max/unit, tied back only by `satisfies Record<SpaceId, readonly ChannelMeta[]>`. That knowledge is what makes the slider possible: ComponentSliders.vue:131 → normalizedChannel → picker-color.ts:160-163 `(channelNumber(color,key) - meta.min) / (meta.max - meta.min)`. Live duplication: kelvin ∈ [1000,40000] is enforced by the library at src/color/model.ts:91 (`if (space === "kelvin" && channels[0] !== "none" && (channels[0] < 1000 || channels[0] > 40000))`) AND re-declared by the demo at picker-color.ts:62 (`{ key: "kelvin", min: 1000, max: 40000, unit: "K" }`).
```

**Reproduction.** `grep -rn "COLOR_SPACE_RANGES\|DENORM_UNITS\|CHANNEL_RANGES" src/` → empty; `grep -n "1000\|40000" src/color/model.ts` → line 91; read picker-color.ts:52-70; read src/subpaths/color.ts in full.

**Proposed cure.** Architectural transposition. The library gains one small export under ./color: `export type ChannelSpec = Readonly<{ key: string; min: number; max: number; unit: "" | "%" | "deg" | "K"; hue?: true; leastCount: 0 | 1 }>; export const CHANNELS: Readonly<Record<SpaceId, readonly ChannelSpec[]>>;`. It is the natural home — the library already owns SpaceId and ChannelsBySpace, and model.ts:91 already enforces one bound. PICKER_CHANNELS becomes a re-export; readoutDecimals becomes spec.leastCount (killing L-7); the kelvin bound has one home; and any REAL consumer building a color slider gets the table instead of re-typing 51 numbers.

```
docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/REPORT.json row safari-desktop-light /#/: counts.canvas=1 (every other picker capture: 2), consoleErrors=['WebGL: context lost.'] (the only console error in all 60 captures), settleMs=18905 (every other capture 3277–3606). shots/safari-desktop-light/picker.png shows no bead. Producer contract: dist/composables/glass/webgpu/rendererStatus.d.ts (phase initializing|ready|error, engine, adapter, error?), exposed as a ref AND emitted by Blob. `grep -rn "rendererStatus\|renderer-status" demo/` → no output.
```

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure: module boundaries, ownershi` · L-4 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** usePaletteWiring routes four cross-cutting colour operations through the picker COMPONENT INSTANCE and silently swaps to different semantics when it is absent — three masking fallbacks plus a 2-second polling retry with a give-up console.warn.

**Mechanism.** Dual path with masking fallback — the same public operation resolves to two different implementations depending on whether an unrelated component happens to be mounted.

**Evidence.**

```
demo/color-picker/composables/usePaletteWiring.ts:65-73 emitApply — picker present -> onPaletteApply(colors) (replaces savedColors with ALL parsed colours); absent -> applyColorString(colors[0]) (sets the CURRENT colour to the first entry, touches no palette). :121-127 emitSetCurrentColor — applyExternalColor vs applyColorString; these are two near-identical implementations in one file (useColorPipeline.ts:182-188 and :247-257): one calls setCurrentColor (refreshing stableHue) and throws on parse failure, the other calls updateModel and swallows the error. :33-58 whenColorPickerReady polls 40 x 50ms then console.warn('gave up waiting for the color picker to mount'), which on mobile ALWAYS exhausts, so emitStartEdit (:106-119) is dead. All of these are pure pipeline calls: App.vue:245 already holds `pipeline` directly, and 5 of ColorPicker's 12 defineExpose members are straight re-exports of inject(COLOR_MODEL_KEY).
```

**Reproduction.** Read demo/color-picker/composables/usePaletteWiring.ts:33-127 alongside demo/color-session/useColorPipeline.ts:182-188 and :247-257. Behavioural repro: at 390x844 (where colorPickerRef is permanently null per L-2) applying a saved palette loads only its first colour into the current swatch instead of replacing savedColors, and starting a palette colour edit logs the give-up warning after ~2s.

**Proposed cure.** Delete the picker parameter, the retry loop and both fallback arms; call the pipeline directly. Then reconcile applyExternalColor and applyColorString into one named operation in color-session.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure: module boundaries, ownershi` · L-5 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** The picker registers a window-level keydown listener in onMounted and releases it only in onUnmounted, but is rendered inside <KeepAlive>, so leaving the picker view deactivates rather than unmounts it and the global shortcut stays live on every other route.

**Mechanism.** Wrong lifecycle pair under KeepAlive: onMounted/onUnmounted instead of onActivated/onDeactivated, in a component whose owner caches it.

**Evidence.**

```
ColorPicker.vue:376-379 onMounted -> window.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeydown); :381-385 onUnmounted -> removeEventListener + two debounce cancels. PaneSlot.vue:120 wraps the pane in <KeepAlive :max="max">. MEASURED live at 1440x900: (1) on #/ fire Cmd+K -> 'Select color space' aria-expanded='true' and [role=listbox] present; (2) Cmd+K again -> closed; (3) navigate to #/browse -> the picker Select is absent from the DOM (pane deactivated); (4) fire Cmd+K on #/browse; (5) navigate back to #/ -> aria-expanded='true', [role=listbox] present. The deactivated picker consumed a global shortcut from a route it does not own. The same hole leaves parseAndSetColorDebounced (2000ms) and updateColorComponentDebounced (500ms) uncancelled on every view switch. Compounding: two keyboard mechanisms for one shortcut set — useMagicKeys() at :247 plus the raw window handler that reads magic-keys state at :263.
```

**Reproduction.** With the dev server on :9000 at 1440x900, in the page context: navigate to '#/', dispatch KeyboardEvent keydown {key:'Meta'} then {key:'k',metaKey:true} on window -> the colour-space Select opens; dispatch again to close; set location.hash='#/browse', wait for the swap, dispatch the same pair; set location.hash='#/' -> the Select is open again (aria-expanded='true').

**Proposed cure.** The shortcut is app-level: move it to a shell-owned keyboard-map composable registered once at the composition root that dispatches to the active instrument. The picker keeps no window listener. Any listener that must live in a KeepAlive'd leaf uses onActivated/onDeactivated.

**Defect.** demo/ui/ is 19 one-line glass-ui forwarding directories with 90 import sites — a directory level the repository's own architecture forbids by name — and it creates a de-facto dual spelling of the same package.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure: module boundaries, ownershi` · L-7 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** ColorPicker.vue holds a second, incorrect implementation of CSS hex validity, and is the fifth of eleven homes for the 'hex is a display encoding, not a space' special case.

**Mechanism.** Duplicate semantic ownership — colour syntax is uniquely the library's, and the display-space encoding policy has no single home, so both are re-decided per call site.

**Evidence.**

```
ColorPicker.vue:224-234 gates on /^#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8}$/ before calling parseAndSetColor. Pasted run against the published parser: '#abc' regex true / library ok; '#abcd' true / ok; '#12345' true / library REJECT; '#abcdef' true / ok; '#1234567' true / library REJECT; '#abcdef12' true / ok. {3,8} admits the two lengths CSS does not define (5 and 7), so garbage passes to a parser that rejects it and triggers the 2s parseError flash (useColorParsing.ts:54-57). `grep -rn '=== "hex"|!== "hex"' demo` -> 11 sites: useColorPipeline.ts:118,176; useColorParsing.ts:66; useSliderGradients.ts:65; useColorNameResolution.ts:43; useColorUrl.ts:55; ColorSpaceSelector.vue:156; readoutReservation.ts:118; ComponentSliders.vue:161; ColorPicker.vue:224.

**Evidence.**

```
demo/picker/controls/ComponentSliders/ComponentSliders.vue:33-38 (rail as detached sibling column), :84-86 (unit glued into meter string), and the four consumer mechanics at :349 (::before hit extension), :384 (::after notch), :363-383 (cursor grammar), :253-274 (gate outline + inset box-shadow). **Reproduction.** NONE — this is a spec-conformance reading, not a runtime failure. The downstream runtime failures it causes (D-3 name divergence, D-4 reservation breach, D-2 target size) each have their own reproduction.

Make the channel row `label · track · unit · value` ONE composition owned by the producer, so the label is programmatically bound to its slider, the unit has a column, the reservation is a producer concern, and the four consumer mechanics have a legitimate home. ### `design (CHALLENGE-D) — visual truth, state coverage, motion,` · D-6 · design (CHALLENGE-D)

**Defect.** In forced colors the touch-gate's REST state paints a permanent 3px black ring and the ACTIVE state loses its entire visual delta. `outline: 3px solid transparent` relies on the colour being invisible, but outline-color is in the forced-colors adjustment set, so it becomes visible at rest. The active state's only two indicators are both colour-only and both erased: its outline-color color-mix is forced to the same black as rest, and its inset box-shadow is forced to `none`. Result: active is pixel-identical to rest. Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4.1 twice — "states are never color-only" and "Focus remains visibly distinct from selection in both schemes, FORCED COLORS and reduced transparency".

**Mechanism.** encoding a state boundary in a colour channel the UA is specified to overwrite — the transparent-colour idiom inverts under forced-colors instead of degrading

**Evidence.**

```

Measured under Playwright forcedColors:"active" at 1440 (scratchpad/CSD-probe.mjs -> CSD-out.json, key forced-colors-1440): gate outline-colors = [rgba(0,0,0,0), rgb(0,0,0), rgb(0,0,0), rgb(0,0,0), rgb(0,0,0)] — all four CHANNEL gates forced from transparent to opaque black at rest, outline-width 3px. box-shadow -> none per CSS Color Adjust 1 §3.2 forced-colors-adjust. ### `design (CHALLENGE-D) — visual truth, state coverage, motion,` · D-7 · design (CHALLENGE-D)

**Defect.** The console claims the Instrument-veil material tier but reveals nothing, and pays a real 469x190 backdrop-filter compositing layer to reveal it. The source itself concedes the outcome ("read OPAQUE — only ~15% of the surviving field variation survives the blur") and books the actual cure out of the lane. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §2 rules on exactly this case: "Glass earns its blur by revealing live content; OTHERWISE IT IS A NEUTRAL WELL", and its tier table assigns Specimen well = "opaque/quiet neutral stage". The console is a well wearing a veil, and the alpha override in D-8 is the symptom of tuning a material toward a tier it cannot occupy.

**Mechanism.** a material tier assigned by intent rather than by what the surface actually composites over, so the tier's cost is paid and its benefit is not delivered

**Evidence.**

```
demo/picker/controls/ComponentSliders/ComponentSliders.vue:25-31 (surface="veil" tier="quiet") and the self-indicting comment at :285-298. Measured on the console element in all matrices (scratchpad/CSD-probe.mjs): background-color = color(srgb 0.953656 0.920577 0.887731 / 0.443), backdrop-filter = blur(7px) saturate(1.4) brightness(1.02), rect 469.06 x 190.33 at 1440. Visually confirmed as a flat warm-cream rectangle on a pink plate in frames/desktop-1440-focus.png and frames/mobile-390-focus.png.
```

**Reproduction.** node scratchpad/CSD-probe.mjs; read consoleBg and consoleBackdrop at any matrix. Visual: frames/desktop-1440-focus.png.

**Proposed cure.** Pick a side — the middle is what produced the override. Either ColorPicker.vue's plate gets its clarity window (the veil becomes earned and the alpha override dies because the material finally does its job) or the console adopts `surface="opaque" tier="quiet"` and both the override and the backdrop cost are deleted. Must execute jointly with the picker-plate half as ONE wave, not two.

### `CHALLENGE-C — implementation (AuroraPane, demo/scenes/atmosp` · C-3 · CHALLENGE-C

**Defect.** guaranteeSeamOffset does not deliver its own stated guarantee, and its 'internal spread preserved' claim is false. The headroom test is computed on the palette MEAN while the clamp is applied per STOP, so extreme stops pin before the mean has travelled; and in the direction-flip branch the required travel is FLOOR+|delta| while the headroom checked was need=FLOOR-|delta|.

**Mechanism.** A closed-form guarantee sized against an aggregate (the mean) but enforced against elements (per-stop clamp). The two quantities diverge exactly at the domain boundary the clamp exists to protect.

**Evidence.**

```
demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:88-90 (the contract) and :99-108 (the implementation: `const headroom = dir === 1 ? 0.98 - meanL : meanL - 0.02; if (headroom < need) dir = -dir; ... clamp(stop.L + push, 0.02, 0.98)`). Measured (probes/pass2/p2-seam.mjs): 'guard FIRED in 1200 cases; guarantee BROKEN in 90 of them', e.g. {"seed":"oklch(0.77 0 25)","h":"analogous","want":0.06,"got":0.0575}; and 'guard fired 120 times; internal L-spread CHANGED in 9', e.g. {"seed":"oklch(0.78 0 25)","spreadBefore":0.32,"spreadAfter":0.30}.
```

**Reproduction.** node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/AuroraPane/probes/pass2/p2-seam.mjs (sections B and C). The demo functions are transcribed verbatim from atmosphere-calibration.ts:95-103 and useAtmosphere.ts:92-110, cited in the probe header.

**Proposed cure.** Clamp-aware and still closed-form: compute the push, apply it, measure the realised mean, and if the clamp ate any of it solve once more against the true per-stop headroom min(0.98 - max(L), min(L) - 0.02). Two passes, no iteration. Or drop the per-stop clamp and let the derive domain own the range. NOTE: code lives in useAtmosphere.ts, not the pane — reported here because it is the referent of the pane's strip and C-2's cure inherits it.

### `CHALLENGE-C — implementation defect hunt · demo/scenes/Confi` · D-1 · CHALLENGE-C

**Defect.** `resetDefaults()` uses a depth-1 `Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults))`, so any live state at depth ≥2 inside a key that also exists on `defaults` is destroyed. On /#/blob it wipes `color.paletteStops` — the picker-derived ramp owned by an external watch — and the watch is keyed on the colour string so it does not re-fire until the user picks a DIFFERENT colour. Silent, no undo, no visible symptom.

**Mechanism.** The stringly-typed reflection layer has no notion of WHICH keys the pane owns, so reset guesses "all top-level keys of defaults". The `sections` prop already declares the owned key domain and is ignored.

**Evidence.**

```
ConfigSliderPane.vue:92-94; writer at demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:389-402. Live probe (scratchpad/probe.mjs, Chromium vs localhost:9000, PUBLIC UI ONLY — Copy JSON → Reset → Copy JSON, clipboard intercepted, no Vue internals): `BLOB pre-reset color.paletteStops: ["#ffbde0","#ffdde5","#fff6f6","#fff6f4"]` → `BLOB post-reset color.paletteStops: ["#b5947f","#d4b27d","#dad6b1"]`. Replacement value confirmed at node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/presets-5myqNv59.js:27-32. Aurora control arm same session: seed survives (`"seed":"lab(92% 88.8 20)"` pre and post) only because aurora-atoms.ts:17-20 deliberately omits it — a consumer-side convention the generic component neither expresses nor enforces.
```

**Reproduction.** node scratchpad/probe.mjs — or by hand: open http://localhost:9000/#/blob, click Copy JSON (paste to see the 4-stop picker-derived ramp), click Reset, click Copy JSON again (3-stop tan triad ['#b5947f','#d4b27d','#dad6b1']). Reproduced byte-identically in two independent audit passes a session apart, via two different instruments.

**Proposed cure.** Reset the DECLARED key domain, not the object: iterate `sections[].defs[].key` and `writePath` each from `defaults`. That makes the reset domain identical to the edit domain by construction, cannot touch an externally-owned member, and makes aurora's seed-omission convention unnecessary. Alternatively adopt glass-ui's `useConfiguratorState<T>` with its `clone` hook — the still-open C10 A4 [P1] book (docs/tranches/N/audit/lanes/C10.md:92-105, :265).

**Mechanism.** Result thrown away — a two-state producer contract collapsed to a fire-and-forget await

**Evidence.**

```
demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-90. Producer contract: glass-ui/dist/useClipboard-D36OTaeT.js — returns `{ok:!1,reason:"no-api"}` when `navigator.clipboard?.writeText` is absent, `{ok:!1,reason:"clipboard-api"}` on rejection. Measured (scratchpad/csp/p3.mjs, both modes forced on the real button): noApi → {bodyTextChanged:false, anyAriaLiveInPane:0, buttonAriaDisabled:null, warns:[]}; rejected → {bodyTextChanged:false, warns:["[useClipboard] clipboard writeText rejected: NotAllowedError: Denied"]}. Success path measured at p2.mjs: visibleFeedbackTextAfter:false.
```

**Reproduction.** `node scratchpad/csp/p3.mjs` and read `clipboard`. Real-world: the repo sets `server.host:true` in vite.config.ts specifically to drive the demo from a phone over `http://<LAN-ip>:9000`; `navigator.clipboard` is secure-context-gated, so on that origin Copy JSON is a dead button on the exact surface the LAN host exists to serve.

**Proposed cure.** Consume the producer's `useClipboard()` — it already ships `status: 'idle'|'pending'|'success'|'failure'` and an `onCopyError(reason)` hook, and glass-ui also exports `toast`/`Toaster`. Bind status to the button and announce it in an `aria-live="polite"` region. Zero new components; edict 4 met by consumption rather than reinvention.

### `CHALLENGE-C — implementation defect hunt on demo/scenes/abou` · K-6 · CHALLENGE-C

**Defect.** Non-`ParseError` throws (TypeError on a non-string expression, RangeError on deeply nested input) bypass `throwOnError: false` entirely, and they escape AFTER `katex.render` has already done `baseNode.textContent = ""` — so the element is left permanently blank and the throw lands in `onMounted` / the watcher callback.

**Mechanism.** The component delegated its whole error policy to a flag whose contract it never read. `throwOnError: false` does not mean "never throws"; it means "swallows exactly one error class". Combined with the vendor's wipe-before-parse ordering, a throw is strictly worse than no render at all.

**Evidence.**

```
node_modules/katex/dist/katex.js:17827-17831 — `render = function (expression, baseNode, options) { baseNode.textContent = ""; const node = renderToDomTree(...).toNode(); baseNode.appendChild(node); }` (wipe first). :17865-17867 — `renderError` re-throws when `options.throwOnError || !(error instanceof ParseError)`.
node probe: `typo \frac{1} => OK len 196 [katex-error span]` / `deep nesting 20000 => THREW RangeError : Maximum call stack size exceeded` / `undefined expr => THREW TypeError : KaTeX can only parse string typed expression`.
Through the component (probes/KTX-repro.test.ts R4/R5 — the failing rows ARE the finding):
  R4 `TypeError: KaTeX can only parse string typed expression` ❯ renderKatex demo/scenes/about/katex/Katex.vue:31:15 ❯ callWithAsyncErrorHandling ❯ hook.__weh.hook.__weh (escapes onMounted)
  R5 `RangeError: Maximum call stack size exceeded` preceded by `[Vue warn]: Unhandled error during execution of watcher callback` (escapes the watch)
Vue also emits `[Vue warn]: Invalid prop: type check failed for prop "expression"` and then calls katex.render with the value anyway.
```

**Reproduction.** npx vitest run --config .../probes/KTX-vitest.config.ts  (cases R4 and R5 — they FAIL, and their stack traces are the evidence). Reachability stated honestly: the RangeError half is a HYPOTHESIS for the current corpus (needs pathological input the 11 static docs do not contain); the TypeError half is one authoring slip away and is caught by no gate (see K-5).

**Proposed cure.** Guard the boundary (`typeof expression === "string"`) and move the render into a `computed` using `renderToString`, which is pure — a throw then leaves the previous DOM intact instead of wiping first, and a `try` around a pure function is natural where a try around a DOM-mutating side effect is not.

### `CHALLENGE-C — implementation defectiveness of demo/scenes/ab` · C-14 · CHALLENGE-C

**Defect.** `currentDoc = ref()` deep-proxies the compiled SFC module and destroys component identity: the object handed to `<component :is>` is !== the module's real export.

**Mechanism.** ref() calls reactive() on any plain object assigned to it. A compiled SFC module is `{ default: { __name, setup, render, __scopeId, ... } }` — a plain object — so Vue walks it and returns a Proxy of the component DEFINITION. <component :is> keys component resolution, keep-alive caching and HMR on definition identity; every property access on the definition during patch traverses a Proxy trap; and reactive tracking is installed on render, setup and the compiled static VNode trees, which are exactly the objects Vue's fast paths assume are raw. This is the repo's standing edict 7 (shallowRef where deep reactivity is wrong) — the same class as the recorded defineModel/shallowRef hazard, applied to a component definition instead of a model value.

**Evidence.**

```
demo/scenes/about/markdown/Markdown.vue:55 `const currentDoc = ref<Awaited<ReturnType<DocModule>> | null>(null);`, read at :64-67 and bound at :16. Measured against Vue's own reactivity via `npx tsx` simulating the exact assignment shape: `ref() -> module isProxy: true | .default isProxy: true | .default isReactive: true`; `shallowRef -> module isProxy: false | .default isProxy: false`; `identity preserved with ref()? false`; `identity preserved with shallow? true`.
```

**Reproduction.** npx tsx -e "import { ref, shallowRef, isReactive, isProxy } from 'vue'; const sfc = { __name:'oklch', setup(){}, render(){}, __scopeId:'data-v-x' }; const mod = { default: sfc }; const r = ref(null); r.value = mod; const s = shallowRef(null); s.value = mod; console.log(isProxy(r.value.default), isReactive(r.value.default), r.value.default === sfc, s.value.default === sfc);" — prints true true false true.

The chain parseCssColor -> convertColor -> INK_AMBIENT_KEY inject -> resolveSurfaceLightnessLive -> certifyAccentInk (distance guard + gamut map + WCAG floor walk, ink.ts:130-141) exists solely to mint --md-color-h2/-h3/-accent for HEADINGS, and nothing asserts heading ink. Same mechanism family as the first seat's C-7 mutations #1/#2 (highlighting subsystem untested), but strictly worse: the machinery left unprotected here IS the contrast-safety machinery, so the one thing a contrast census exists to guarantee is the one thing this contrast census does not measure.

**Evidence.**

```
`grep -rn "md-color|markdown-body > h|cs-name" e2e/` returns NO MATCHES. The sole gate is e2e/smoke/oracles/o18-contrast-census.spec.ts:745-777, which asserts contrast on `.markdown-body p` (which inherits --foreground) and `pre code, p > code` — never heading ink. Cross-check: `grep -rln 'useMarkdownColors|useMarkdownHighlighting|highlightColorSpaceName|markdown-body|markdown-wrapper' test/ demo/test/ e2e/` returns exactly one file (o18). Zero unit tests, zero component tests; demo/test/ holds only export/, glass/, palettes/. ```

Both mutations leave the full suite green.

**Proposed cure.** W-MD-5 must carry a heading-ink oracle, not only the highlighting vitest suite: for each of the 11 docs, assert --md-color-h2 resolves to a value distinct from --foreground AND clears the text contrast floor against the live resting-plate ground. ```

**Reproduction.** node probes/pass-4/csp-d4-probe3.mjs webkit "#/blob" 1440 900 light wk-blob-light  → prints veil opacity/headerRect at rest and at scrollTop 600 and writes csp-d4-wk-blob-light-scrolled600.png. node probes/pass-4/csp-d4-probe5.mjs {chromium|webkit} "#/blob" 1440 900 light <tag> → prints the scale/effectivePx divergence.

**Proposed cure.** THE GESTALT CURE — architectural transposition, not a patch. Extract the prose theme out of the SFC into a document/prose primitive: glass-ui per edict 4, or demo/styles/prose.css as the interim home if that producer seam is out of reach this tranche. Markdown.vue:309-314 styles them: `border-color: var(--md-color-h2, var(--border)); opacity: 0.3`. Measured effective contrast against the plate: 1.78:1 (evidence/M1-measure-desktop-light.json -> hr-effective-vs-plate), from a certified 6.58:1 ink; WCAG 1.4.11 non-text minimum is 3:1. Forced colors: {"borderTopColor":"rgb(0, 0, 0)", "opacity":"0.3"} — the author opacity is not reset (evidence/M5-rtl-forced-colors.json, visible in evidence/E5-forced-colors-desktop.png). ### `CHALLENGE-D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, ` · D-10 · CHALLENGE-D

**Defect.** The declared golden-ratio ladder is not the rendered ladder — 20 of 33 adjacent-sibling intervals are collapsed margins, and PR-35 requires About's collapsed-margin count to be recorded as 0.

**Mechanism.** Every interval is declared twice — as the preceding block's margin-bottom and the following block's margin-top — and normal-flow sibling margin collapse renders the max of the two. The intended rhythm therefore cannot be read off the stylesheet, which is precisely what a proportion register must be able to do.

**Evidence.**

```
OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:100 (PR-35): "No margin collapse..." and "record ... collapsed-margin count `0`". Measured collapsedCount = 20 of 33 (evidence/M2-rhythm-inks-light.json -> rhythm, collapsedCount). Representative rows: UL->H3 declares 16px + 25.875px = 41.88 sum, renders 25.88; P->HR declares 16px + 41.875px = 57.88, renders 41.88; HR->H2 declares 41.875px + 41.875px = 83.75, renders 41.88. The `> p { margin-bottom: var(--phi-2) }` rung (Markdown.vue:194) is entirely swallowed before every heading and every rule — most of the document. The file's own comment (:92-96) claims the rhythm comes from "one golden-ratio spacing ladder ... never ad-hoc steps".
```

**Reproduction.** node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/Markdown/evidence/probe4.mjs light — read collapsedCount and the full 33-row rhythm table.

**Proposed cure.** One owner per interval: either a flow container (`> * + * { margin-block-start: ... }` or gap on a flex-column body) so each gap is declared exactly once, or block-start-only margins throughout. Land in the W-MD-0 primitive. Acceptance: collapsedCount === 0 and every rendered gap equals a declared phi rung.

The tracked matrix includes `rtl-desktop/picker.png`, so RTL is an audited state of this build.

**Proposed cure.** Wrap the range cell in `<bdi dir="ltr">` (or emit one text node `${min}–${max}` with an en-dash and no interleaved element); move the colon from content into `::after`; put `dir="ltr"` on the ordered channel grid; give the connector `rtl:-scale-x-100` or replace the glyph with a logical mark.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-5 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** `tsconfig.demo.json` `paths` ≠ `package.json` `exports`: 3 of 8 entries point at non-existent files, 2 published subpaths are absent, and a `paths` hit shadows the exports map — so the demo's dogfood-the-published-surface claim is unenforced for 5 of 7 subpaths.

**Mechanism.** Two resolution mechanisms live simultaneously for one surface. A `paths` entry short-circuits `exports`, so the exports map is not load-bearing for 5 of 7 subpaths; the Vite alias set is generated FROM exports, so typecheck surface and runtime surface are decoupled. The dead entries and the stale bare-specifier rationale are the fossil record of glass-ui ≤6.

**Defect.** The single class name coupling this component to the build pipeline — .markdown-body — is an undeclared default of a floating third-party dependency range, owned by neither the component nor the repo, with four in-repo dependents not one of which can report its own absence.

**Mechanism.** An abstention from declaring a contract. Markdown({}) is not a neutral call — the feature stands on an upstream default under a caret range, so an upstream minor can retire it and the repo's response would be ~100 dead typography rules plus vanished colour-space marking, with green CI. Compounding it, two mechanisms serve one concept: site 1 relies on Vue propagating the parent's scope id onto a CHILD COMPONENT's root element; sites 2-3 rely on ordinary descendant matching. Site 1 additionally dies if the .md wrapper ever renders a fragment or wrapperDiv:false is set — the identical silent-dead-rule failure class the SFC's own comment at :81-97 documents having already suffered once for the inner elements. The cure landed for the inner elements and left the root on the old mechanism.

**Evidence.**

```
Producer: `grep -n 'Markdown(' vite.config.ts` → "162: Markdown({})," (zero options); `grep -n 'wrapperClasses: "markdown-body"' node_modules/unplugin-vue-markdown/dist/src-5Xwh9b7i.mjs` → :281; types-CAs0WWKP.d.mts:166 "@default 'markdown-body'" with a sibling `wrapperDiv?: boolean` that makes the class vanish entirely when false; package.json devDependencies → unplugin-vue-markdown ^32.0.0 (floating minor). Four consumers, all silent on failure: Markdown.vue:98 (compiles to `.markdown-body[data-v-b622b24b]`), Markdown.vue:104 and :198 (both compile to `.markdown-wrapper[data-v-b622b24b] .markdown-body` — emitted TWICE, verified by json-decoding __vite__css from the dev server's scoped-style module: 10246 bytes, three selectors, two identical), and useMarkdownHighlighting.ts:11 `container.querySelector(".markdown-body")` guarded by `:12 if (!body) return;`.
```

**Reproduction.** The four greps and the compiled-CSS decode in the evidence field are fully reproduced. The BREAKAGE is a hypothesis — this seat may not edit source, so I did not stage an upstream bump; the failure is proved by mechanism and by the `if (!body) return;` early-out at useMarkdownHighlighting.ts:12, not by observed regression.

**Proposed cure.** Immediate, one line, and the same line that cures L-4: `Markdown({ wrapperClasses: "markdown-body" })` at vite.config.ts:162 — declare the seam the repo actually depends on. Architecturally better: under the greenfield lattice the seam disappears rather than being declared — the stylesheet moves to demo/styles/prose.css keyed on a class the repo owns, and markSpaceName.ts receives the container element from useTemplateRef instead of re-finding it by string. A concept that no longer needs a name shared across a package boundary cannot drift across one. Lands inside wave MD-a; closing evidence `grep -c 'wrapperClasses' vite.config.ts` = 1.

The stated justification does not even hold for the consumer it was minted for — useMarkdownColors DOES certify a whole colour through certifyAccentInk, the identical call safeCss makes with identical arguments. ### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-5 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** The doc registry lives in the consumer, the content lives outside demo/, and the edge between them is a directory-level dependency cycle. The colour-space domain is enumerated twice, with a load-bearing cast proving the two are not known to agree.

**Mechanism.** Split ownership plus an inverted edge. The markdown/ module owns the TYPE of a doc loader but cannot resolve its own content, so its single consumer must hand it one — the indirection buys nothing and costs the registry its home. Meanwhile 11 demo components live outside demo/ and import back into demo/scenes/about/, making the content un-relocatable: moving scenes/about/katex/ breaks 11 files outside the app tree. And the parallel enumeration fails silently — add a space to DisplayColorSpace and the lookup returns undefined, the v-if at AboutPane.vue:51 hides the guide, nothing errors.

**Evidence.**

```
AboutPane.vue:79 `type MarkdownSpace = "rgb"|"hex"|...|"kelvin"` hand-copies DisplayColorSpace (demo/color-session/color-model.ts:31); :81-93 holds the 11-entry registry as `() => import("../../../assets/docs/rgb.md")`; :97 casts `as MarkdownSpace`. The cycle: AboutPane.vue:82 -> assets/docs/*.md (repo-root sibling of demo/), and `grep -rn 'import .* from' assets/docs/*.md` → all 11 files line 2 `import { Katex } from "../../demo/scenes/about/katex";`. Those .md files are compiled as Vue SFCs (vite.config.ts:161 `Vue({ include: [/\.vue$/, /\.md$/] })`; assets/docs/lab.md:1 is `<script setup>` — confirmed by fetching it from the dev server).
```

**Reproduction.** The greps above, fully reproduced by this seat (the 11-way assets/docs -> demo/scenes/about/katex edge independently confirmed).

**Proposed cure.** Move assets/docs/ -> demo/scenes/about/docs/ (they are demo components; nothing else reads them); the Katex import becomes "../katex" — one hop, no inversion — and assets/ is removed entirely. Move the registry behind the module seam keyed off the canonical union: `export const colorSpaceDocs: Record<DisplayColorSpace, () => Promise<Component>>`. Record<DisplayColorSpace,...> is exhaustive by construction, so a new space becomes a compile error and the `as` cast dies. Wave MD-d.

**Defect.** `useMarkdownColors` is a bespoke resolver that recomputes, per frame, a value the boot writer already publishes on `:root` as `--accent-live` — violating `demo/DESIGN.md:334` ("the SAME computation SAFE_ACCENT_KEY provides; ONE color-resolution path, never a bespoke resolver"). ### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-2 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** glass-ui ships a complete Configurator surface (Configurator, ConfiguratorLayer, ConfiguratorRow, useConfiguratorState, CONFIGURATOR_SIZE_KEY, ConfiguratorPreset, ConfiguratorScrollMode) and the demo consumes exactly ONE of its seven exports, hand-rebuilding the rest as a 253-line demo-local component. Owner edict 4 violation (glass-ui is the design system).

**Mechanism.** Design-system component duplicated in the consumer; the demo-local copy then becomes the home of defects the producer surface had already solved (see L-3).

**Evidence.**

```
node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/configurator.d.ts lists 7 export groups. `grep -rn 'useConfiguratorState|ConfiguratorLayer|<Configurator' demo` → zero hits; only demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:21 imports ConfiguratorRow. The rebuild map: section grouping = ConfiguratorLayer/layers prop vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:128-131 + :232-243; scroll port = scrollMode="auto" (FadingScroll) vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:106 .pane-scroll-fade; footer+reset = #footer slot with `reset` + @reset emit vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:163-174 + :245-251; row density = `size: sm|md|lg` cascading via CONFIGURATOR_SIZE_KEY vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:215-217 `:deep(.configurator-row){min-block-size:clamp(...)}`; reset/dirty/presets = useConfiguratorState<T> (resetCurrent, isDirty, selectPreset, clone hook) vs ConfigSliderPane.vue:92-94 Object.assign. ConfiguratorRow's own doc block credits 'the double-label API (value.js L14)' — the coordination channel that put it in the producer was used once, then abandoned.
```

**Reproduction.** `cat node_modules/@mkbabb/glass-ui/dist/configurator.d.ts` then `grep -rn 'useConfiguratorState\|ConfiguratorLayer\|<Configurator' demo` (zero hits) against demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue (253 lines).

**Proposed cure.** Delete demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue outright. Move both consumers (BlobPane, AuroraPane) onto <Configurator> + <ConfiguratorLayer> + useConfiguratorState. Every row in the rebuild map above disappears with it, including the hand-rolled reset that causes L-3 and the :deep() overrides of L-8.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-3 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** ConfigSliderPane's Reset performs a SHALLOW Object.assign over an 8-atom NESTED config, so it replaces `config.color` wholesale — destroying `color.paletteStops`, an atom BlobPane deliberately does not expose and useAtmosphere owns and writes.

**Mechanism.** Hand-rolled reset (L-2) over a nested config, combined with split ownership of a single atom: paletteStops has a writer in boot and a blind resetter in a scene component. The bug is invisible today ONLY because L-1 masks it (the sole <Blob> overrides paletteStops with its own derivation) — two defects cancelling, not a working system.

**Evidence.**

```
demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:92-94 `function resetDefaults(){ Object.assign(config, structuredClone(defaults)); }`. BlobPane.vue:8-9 declares paletteStops 'the live picker-palette feed ... not a slider'. Writer is demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:390-403 (a watch on atmosphereColor). MEASURED via scratchpad/probe/injected.mjs on the live server: INJECTED blobConfig BEFORE reset = ["#ffbde0","#ffdde5","#fff6f6","#fff6f4"] (4 live pink stops); AFTER Reset = ["#b5947f","#d4b27d","#dad6b1"] — the 3 canned brown literals baked into BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS.color.paletteStops (glass-ui/dist/presets-5myqNv59.js). It stays clobbered because the writer is a colour watch and Reset does not change the colour.
```

**Reproduction.** `node scratchpad/probe/injected.mjs` — loads /#/blob, reads the provided Symbol(blobConfig).color.paletteStops off the component tree, clicks Reset, re-reads. 4 live stops become 3 canned browns.

**Proposed cure.** useConfiguratorState<T>.resetCurrent() with its `clone` hook resets against the active preset baseline and never touches atoms outside it. Structurally the deeper cure is L-6: the pane owns its config outright, so there is no externally-owned atom inside the object it resets.

**Defect.** Two implementations of 'derive the blob palette from the live colour' are alive; the one in the boot composable is dead code whose output is never rendered, yet it runs once per animation frame during a colour drag.

useAtmosphere.ts:384-403 vs HeroBlob.vue:117-132 — same deriveBlobPalette call, different chromaCeiling (flat 0.16 vs Math.max(0.16, seed.C)), only the HeroBlob one applies floorStops(). The boot value's only reader is HeroBlob.vue:79 (`shallowRef([...appBlobConfig.color.paletteStops])`), superseded in the same setup tick by the {immediate:true} watch at HeroBlob.vue:132. COST measured with scratchpad/probe/bench-derive.mjs (Node 24, 20 000 iterations): `deriveBlobPalette+hex per call: 50.98 us   total 1019.6 ms for 20000`. demo/color-session/useAtmosphereFrameCoalesce.ts:10-14 names 'the blob-palette derive (both in useAtmosphere)' as one of three heavy derives it exists to coalesce — the coalescer is protecting a computation nobody consumes.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-6 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** One concept (the blob config) has three owners across three areas and no module named for it: created and provided by an app BOOT composable, written and reset by a scenes component, overridden and rendered by a picker-scene component. The pane has no stage at all, and on mobile the tuning surface and the blob are mutually exclusive.

**Mechanism.** No module is named for the concept, so the provide site (which must be App-scoped) became the de-facto owner, and each consumer patched what it needed where it stood.

**Evidence.**

```
Created/provided: demo/color-picker/composables/boot/useAtmosphere.ts:381-382. Palette written (dead): :393. Sliders written: demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:66-82 on behalf of BlobPane. Reset: :92-94. Overridden+rendered: demo/picker/visual/HeroBlob.vue:152-178. BlobPane's only link is the undeclared runtime edge `inject(BLOB_CONFIG_KEY)!` (BlobPane.vue:17). MOBILE: demo/shell/viewSchema.ts:179-187 defines blob as {left:'color-picker', right:'blob'} and demo/shell/usePaneRouter.ts:178-185 resolves the mobile slot to desktopLeft at pane-index 0, so /#/blob opens on the Picker segment — confirmed in docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-mobile-light/blob.png (segmented control [Picker]|Blob with Picker active, no config sliders rendered) and corroborated by REPORT.md's tap-target rows: desktop /#/blob = 39 small targets, mobile /#/blob = 8, i.e. the 35 sliders are not on screen.
```

**Reproduction.** Read the six call sites above; open docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/visual/shots/safari-mobile-light/blob.png — the route named 'blob' shows no blob pane.

**Proposed cure.** Greenfield lattice: demo/scenes/blob/useBlobConfig.ts = a module-scoped `reactive(structuredClone(BLOB_CONFIG_DEFAULTS))` + the ONE deriveBlobPalette+ink-floor owner + `BLOB_PRESETS: ConfiguratorPreset<BlobConfig>[]`, importing @mkbabb/glass-ui/blob-config only; demo/scenes/blob/BlobStudio.vue = <Configurator> with a #stage <Blob> driven by useConfiguratorState; HeroBlob imports useBlobConfig and selects the 'hero' preset. A module singleton is the idiomatic Vue 3.5 shape for app-wide state with two known consumers — it kills the provide/inject, the boot coupling, the `!` assertion, L-1, L-3 and L-4 in one move.

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure (module boundaries, ownershi` · L-3 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** Katex.vue owns none of its own box model. class="inline-block" is hardcoded on the root regardless of displayMode (which defaults true), and the block/scroll correction lives in a sibling component's scoped stylesheet keyed on a direct-child relationship. Any instance not a direct child of .markdown-body overflows unclipped and unscrollable.

**Mechanism.** unique-semantic-ownership violation: layout semantics of a prop implemented in a foreign module; the AB-1 dead-CSS failure class localised to one call pattern and left latent everywhere else

**Evidence.**

```
Katex.vue:2 `<div class="inline-block" ref="katexElement">`; Katex.vue:22 `displayMode = true` default; Markdown.vue:301-306 `> div.inline-block:has(> .katex-display) { display:block; @apply overflow-x-auto; … }`; Markdown.vue:286-289 owns inline spacing. Live WebKit measurement at 1440x900 on http://localhost:9000/#/ : {"before":{"display":"block","overflowX":"auto","sw":462,"cw":462},"inP":{"display":"inline-block","overflowX":"visible"},"outside":{"display":"inline-block","overflowX":"visible","hostW":300,"boxW":557}} — 557px box in a 300px host, 257px unclipped overflow.
```

**Reproduction.** scratchpad/latent-probe.mjs — relocate a live display-mode instance (a) into a <p> inside .markdown-body, (b) into a 300px host outside it; read getComputedStyle + scrollWidth. Output pasted in report §L-3.

**Proposed cure.** The component owns its own display: `<div :class="displayMode ? 'katex-block' : 'katex-inline'">` with `.katex-block { display:block; overflow-x:auto }` in its own <style scoped>; delete Markdown.vue:286-306. Under the build-time cure the transform emits a semantic <figure class="math-display"> that owns its overflow and no :has() reach exists at all.

Markdown.vue:287,288,301 select `div.inline-block`; Katex.vue:2 is the sole producer. ### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure: module boundaries, ownershi` · L-7 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** The coarse-pointer hit-area extension re-mints a utility glass-ui already ships, cures the axis that was already passing, and is a measured no-op on its own axis.

**Mechanism.** A producer-owned a11y concern was re-solved consumer-side, at half the scope, against the producer's internal class names, for a defect whose real axis the re-mint does not touch. It also borrows the dock's `--dock-touch-target` where the general `--touch-target` is the right token (both 2.75rem today, so scope-borrow not breakage).

**Evidence.**

```
demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:218-230 sets `block-size: max(100%, var(--dock-touch-target, 2.75rem))` on a `::before`. glass-ui ships `@utility touch-hit-area` (dist/styles/utilities/a11y-overrides.css) with BOTH `min-width` and `min-height`, and `[data-control-target]` (dist/styles/utilities/responsive.css) with both `min-block-size` and `min-inline-size`. Measured at 1024 with hasTouch: `{pointerCoarse:true, sliderHostHeight:44, pseudoBlockSize:"44px"}` — glass-ui's own coarse density clamp (dist/styles/tokens/light-dark.css `--control-floor: var(--touch-target)`) already brings `.glass-slider` from 24px (fine) to 44px (coarse), so `max(44px, 44px)` is a no-op. The failing axis is width: thumb measured 12×24 at 1440 and 12×44 at 390 coarse — a pseudo on the parent cannot change the focusable element's box.
```

**Reproduction.** Launch WebKit at 1024×768 with hasTouch, goto /#/blob: `matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches` → true, `.glass-slider` height 44 both with and without the demo rule; `.slider-thumb` width stays 12.

**Proposed cure.** Delete :218-230. Fix the width at its root by dropping `variant="spectrum"` (L-2); if a hit extension is still wanted, apply the producer's `touch-hit-area` utility or `[data-control-target]`.

WebKit 1440x900 measurement of the four rows: trigger left = 318.1 / 365.1 / 306.4 / 306.4 (58.7px spread), label widths 82.1 / 129.1 / 70.4 / 70.4. `labelAssociated: false` (no .aurora-row-label carries for= or id=). ```

### `CHALLENGE-L — library structure: module boundaries, ownershi` · L-6 · CHALLENGE-L

**Defect.** ConfigSliderPane's public surface is stringly typed (`config: Record<string, unknown>`, `SliderDef.key: string`), so type safety cannot be enforced at the boundary and is instead re-derived per consumer — BlobPane wrote a 30-line mapped-type guard, AuroraPane has none.

**Mechanism.** `Record<string, unknown>` + `key: string` is the type-theoretic equivalent of no contract; a shared module that cannot express its own invariant pushes the invariant into every caller, and two callers produced two different answers.

**Evidence.**

```
demo/scenes/ConfigSliderPane.vue:27-40 declares `export interface SliderDef { key: string; … }` and props `config: Record<string, unknown>` / `defaults: Record<string, unknown>`. The complete set of laundering casts in the demo is exactly the four call sites of this component: AuroraPane.vue:111 `(atoms as unknown) as Record<string, unknown>`, AuroraPane.vue:113, BlobPane.vue:124, BlobPane.vue:126. BlobPane.vue:19-45 re-invents path validity in ~30 lines of mapped types with the comment "A typo or an abrogated key fails typecheck here rather than silently no-op'ing a slider". AuroraPane.vue:97-106 declares "colorEnergy", "noise", "zones.count" as bare strings with no equivalent guard.
```

**Reproduction.** grep -rn "as unknown) as Record<string, unknown>" demo  -> exactly four lines, all four call sites of ConfigSliderPane. Read ConfigSliderPane.vue:28 — `key: string` admits every string.

**Proposed cure.** Make the pane a generic SFC (`<script setup lang="ts" generic="T extends object">`) with `SliderDef<T> { key: NumericPath<T>; … }` and `config: T; defaults: T`. Move BlobPane's NumericPath mapped type INTO the shared module where it is written once. All four `as unknown as` casts disappear, BlobPane's guard is hoisted rather than deleted, and AuroraPane gains the guard it never had. Vue 3.5 supports generic defineProps today — no contrivance.

### `D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-sys` · D-3 · D

**Defect.** Four style declarations on the Select trigger are dead — the rendered component is not the component that was designed, and nothing says so. Consequence: the selected value of all four controls renders italic sans at the label's own size.

Owner edict 5 ('style at the shadcn/glass root component level, never per-instance overrides') violated four times, four silent failures. The italic arrives free from the producer and the component accepts it; in this app italic is the pane-DESCRIPTION register (PaneHeader.vue:29 .pane-header-desc), so the row's protagonist wears the voice of explanatory prose and reads as placeholder text.

**Proposed cure.** Delete all four per-instance classes. ### `D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-sys` · D-7 · D

**Defect.** The visible label is not a label. Clicking 'HARMONY' does nothing: no focus, no open, no pointer affordance.

**Mechanism.** The hand-rolled row (D-4) skipped the label association that ConfiguratorRow's `label` prop supplies to the sibling slider rows (ConfigSliderPane.vue:139). A <span> styled exactly like a form label, positioned exactly where one goes, doing none of a form label's work — no for, no aria-labelledby, no click-to-focus, no hit-area contribution. Secondary: the accessible name is a second vocabulary ('Palette harmony' / 'Zone arrangement' / 'Painterly medium' / 'Motion register') against the visible 'HARMONY' / 'ARRANGEMENT' / 'MEDIUM' / 'MOTION' — each contains its visible string so WCAG 2.5.3 is not breached, but two names for one knob is a seat-law defect (PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:70-71).

**Evidence.**

```
probe-D2.json.labelClick — before { expanded:'false', focused:'BODY' }; after clicking .aurora-row-label 'Harmony': { expanded:'false', focused:'BODY', listboxOpen:false, labelCursor:'auto' }. probe-D.json rows: labelTag 'SPAN', labelHasFor false, trigAriaLabelledby null. AuroraPane.vue:120,140,154,168 are bare <span class="aurora-row-label">.
```

**Reproduction.** node probe-D2.mjs, or click the word HARMONY at http://localhost:9000/#/atmosphere and observe nothing happens.

**Proposed cure.** Covered by D-4: ConfiguratorRow's label prop restores the association, the click target and the pointer affordance. Then collapse the two vocabularies to one name per knob.

### `D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-sys` · D-8 · D

**Defect.** Typographic hierarchy is exactly inverted: the leaf control label and the group section title compute byte-identical, while the leaf label and its PEER leaf label differ in family, weight, tracking, case and colour. Label:value size ratio is 1.000 on desktop and 0.667 on mobile — the relation inverts direction between viewports.

**Mechanism.** AuroraPane.vue:194-200 copies .config-section-title's exact recipe onto a leaf label, so rank information is destroyed. The colour split compounds it: enum labels are muted rgb(112,89,66) while peer slider labels are full-strength rgb(28,25,23), making the four enum rows read as secondary/disabled when all seven are peer atoms of one AuroraAtoms door. The label and value rungs resolve from two different clamps (--type-small vs the producer's trigger size) that cross between 390px and 1440px.

**Evidence.**

```
probe-D2.json.voice — .aurora-row-label 'Harmony' (LEAF): Fira Code 16.4px w400 ls 1.64px uppercase rgb(112,89,66). .config-section-title 'Field' (GROUP): Fira Code 16.4px w400 ls 1.64px uppercase rgb(112,89,66) — identical. .configurator-row 'Colour Energy' (PEER LEAF): Plus Jakarta Sans 16.4px w500 ls normal none rgb(28,25,23). Proportion: desktop label 16.4px : value 16.4px = 1.000; mobile label 14px : value 21px = 0.667. Canon: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:15 requires paired rungs at label/headline = 1/√φ ≈ 0.786; :16 'Mobile and desktop use the same source.'
```

**Reproduction.** node probe-D2.mjs → out.voice. Visually: shots/safari-desktop-light/atmosphere.png — 'HARMONY' and 'FIELD' are indistinguishable; 'HARMONY' and 'Colour Energy' look like different kinds of thing.

**Proposed cure.** D-4's cure gives all seven rows one label voice. Then set the label/value pair from ONE paired clamp so the 1/√φ relation holds at every arm, per PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:15-16, instead of two independently-clamped rungs.

### `D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-sys` · D-9 · D

**Defect.** Nothing the pane does survives a reload — including the app's only ambient-motion stop control. The sole export is write-only and silently carries the user's live colour.

**Mechanism.** The atoms object is component-lifetime reactive state with no workspace persistence layer. The Motion select IS the app's only still control, but it is route-local (behind a Dock navigation), named 'Motion register' rather than announced as a motion control, and not remembered. The escape hatch — Copy JSON (ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-90) — serialises `config`, which useAtmosphere.ts:132-139 has written the live picker `seed` onto, and no import path exists anywhere in the app.

**Evidence.**

```
probe-D2.json.persistence = { set: 'Still', afterReload: 'Drifting', persisted: false }. useAtmosphere.ts:128 is `reactive(structuredClone(DEFAULT_AURORA_ATOMS))` with no storage read or write in the chain. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:145 'Continuous Aurora/Blob ambient motion terminates within five seconds or exposes one persistent keyboard-operable still/pause control whose state is announced and remembered'; :99 'Persistent operation state stays with the entity/workspace.'
```

**Reproduction.** node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/AuroraPane/probe-D2.mjs; or at http://localhost:9000/#/atmosphere set Motion → Still, reload, observe Drifting.

**Proposed cure.** Persist the atoms to the workspace so the still state is remembered (§145) and operation state stays with the workspace (§99). Either give Copy JSON a matching import, or replace the write-only export with real persistence and drop it.

### `D — design (visual truth, state coverage, motion, design-sys` · D-10 · D

**Defect.** The four advanced enum atoms consume 42.3% of the pane's control acreage and sit ABOVE the three essentials, pushing them below the fold; the mobile scroll clip falls between the 'Noise 0.500' label and the slider it names.

**Mechanism.** AuroraPane places its enum block in ConfigSliderPane's default slot, which ConfigSliderPane.vue:110 renders ABOVE the slider sections. So the least-frequently-changed, most-exotic knobs occupy the first screen and the continuous knobs that give immediate feedback are scrolled away. ConfigSliderPane.vue:104-105 explicitly reasoned about the footer never occluding a slider but not about the scroll boundary bisecting a row.

**Evidence.**

```
Measured: enumBlockH 192.00 (both viewports — the rows do not scale, D-5) vs wellH 261.77 desktop / 307.78 mobile → 192/(192+261.77) = 42.3% desktop, 38.4% mobile. Scroll: mobile scrollH 632 clientH 456 → 176px hidden = 27.8%; zoom-200 scrollH 567 clientH 259 → 308px hidden = 54.3%; desktop 574/574 → 0. Canon: VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:51 order is 'preview, essentials, advanced'.
```

**Reproduction.** node probe-D.mjs → out['mobile'].acreage.scrollClipped {scrollH:632, clientH:456, hidden:176} and out['zoom-200'].acreage.scrollClipped {scrollH:567, clientH:259, hidden:308}. Visually: shots/safari-mobile-light/atmosphere.png — the cut falls between 'Noise 0.500' and its slider.

**Proposed cure.** Part of D-1's transposition: reorder to preview → essentials (colour energy, noise, zones) → scroll-confined advanced disclosure (harmony, arrangement, medium, motion), per VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:51.

### `design` · D-4 · design

**Defect.** A certified text-ink token (`--ink-muted`, specified at >=4.5:1 for glyph mass) is used as a ~23,000px2 area fill, making the inert track the pane's heaviest and near-loudest object.

**Mechanism.** Text ink is specified for a few-hundred-px2 glyph mass; applied to continuous surface it is a different optical object — it reads as a painted bar, not a groove at adequate contrast. Violates VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:14-16 (tier separation: instrument veil vs specimen well) and :21 ("Dark chrome uses the restrained neutral pole"). PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:73 law 8: "Real rendered relation wins over token intent ... token presence alone cannot close a row" — the comment at :190-201 closes its row on token presence.

**Evidence.**

```
ConfigSliderPane.vue:202 `--slider-track-bg: var(--ink-muted, var(--muted-foreground))`. Measured (chD-csp-probe2.mjs): track vs well 5.82:1 light / 8.30:1 dark; row label vs well 13.52:1 / 9.28:1; section heading 5.08:1 / 5.97:1. In dark mode the inert track sits within one stop of the label. Track geometry 962x24 on /atmosphere, 432x24 on /blob.
```

**Reproduction.** node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe2.mjs -> contrast-light / contrast-dark

**Proposed cure.** Fold into D-3. The track's material belongs to the producer Slider's neutral recipe at its own graphics rung; if that rung is genuinely below 3:1 on --well-bg, the fix is a glass-ui `--slider-track-*` token pair sized for area, not a consumer re-ink borrowed from the text ladder.

### `design` · D-5 · design

**Defect.** 31 slider thumbs render 12x24px — below the WCAG 2.5.8 24x24 minimum on the inline axis — and the component's hit-area extension is gated to `@media (pointer: coarse)`, so desktop is uncovered.

**Mechanism.** WCAG 2.5.8 is not pointer-type-conditional. The coarse-only guard leaves pointer:fine uncovered, and on /blob the coarse arm is dead code anyway because the pane is not rendered at coarse-pointer widths (D-2). PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:72 law 7 explicitly licenses extending the operable target without growing the visual glyph.

**Evidence.**

```
REPORT.json safari-desktop-light /#/blob a11y.smallTapTargets: 39 entries, 31 of them exactly {w:12,h:24,tag:"span"} labelled with every BlobPane slider (Body Radius ... Speed). Identical in safari-desktop-dark. Live: thumb {w:12,h:24} at both 1440 and 390. Cure gate: ConfigSliderPane.vue:218-230. Mobile arm proves the cure works (REPORT.json safari-mobile-light channel spans h:44; /atmosphere mobile rows h 57.59).
```

**Reproduction.** http://localhost:9000/#/blob at 1440px; inspect any [role="slider"] inside .config-console — 12x24 CSS px.

**Proposed cure.** Delete the `pointer: coarse` guard and move the hit extension onto the glass-ui Slider thumb (unconditional), retiring the consumer `:deep()` block entirely. PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:56 PR-12 already owns this family at W18.

### `design` · D-6 · design

**Defect.** The pane emits 8 dividing lines on /blob where the binding boundary inventory specifies `none`, and the section rule is scheme-asymmetric: invisible in light (1.08:1), a hard rule in dark (5.03:1).

**Mechanism.** Duplicative boundary: PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:69 law 4 retains a divider only when grouping would be ambiguous without it, and the pane already separates sections with gap-5 plus a distinct heading. `color-mix(in srgb, var(--border) 50%, transparent)` over --well-bg is invisible in one scheme and crisp in the other, a 4.7x swing for one element. Under forced colors this forbidden rule is the only surviving element in the pane (D-1) — a precise inversion of design priority.

```
Live /#/blob: sectionHeaders 7, actionBars 1 = 8 lines. Sources: ConfigSliderPane.vue:232-235 (.config-section-header border-bottom, one per section) and :245-251 (.config-action-bar border-top). OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:80-81 gives Atmosphere and Blob `Retained non-P122 dividing line: none`; :90 "Any additional line ... is a defect". Measured divider vs well: 1.08:1 light, 5.03:1 dark (chD-csp-probe2.mjs).

### `design` · D-7 · design

**Defect.** A section heading and a control label are computed-identical (6/6 properties), the section heading is the same size as the row labels it groups, and the closed type matrix is breached in three roles.

**Mechanism.** VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:66-78 is a closed type matrix. Section heading must be text-heading/Plus Jakarta Sans — rendered Fira Code 16.4px caps. Control label must be text-small PJS non-bold — rendered Fira Code caps in the slot rows and PJS weight 500 in the well rows. Value must be text-mono-small or mono-caption — rendered text-micro 11px, neither token. Mono is thus louder as a heading (16.4px) than as the data it groups (11px), and FIELD vs HARMONY are indistinguishable in the frame.

**Evidence.**

```
/#/atmosphere 1440x900 (chD-csp-probe3.mjs -> twoSpecies.identicalRecipe): .config-section-title (ConfigSliderPane.vue:237-243) vs .aurora-row-label (AuroraPane.vue:194-199) — fontFamily, fontSize (16.4px), textTransform (uppercase), letterSpacing (1.64px), color rgb(112,89,66), fontWeight 400 — all six equal, and the two CSS blocks are byte-identical in five declarations in the same order. Sizes: section title 16.4px == row label 16.4px (desktop) and 14px == 14px (390px); value 11px at both. Label/value ratio drifts 1.49 (desktop) -> 1.27 (mobile).
```

**Reproduction.** node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe3.mjs -> twoSpecies.identicalRecipe / .secTitles / .rowLabels; visual: shots/safari-mobile-dark/atmosphere.png (FIELD and HARMONY render identically).

**Proposed cure.** One matrix line per role: section headings -> text-heading (Plus Jakarta Sans), restoring a real size step above the row label; the mono/caps/tracking recipe survives in exactly one place, the value/provenance voice. The duplicated .aurora-row-label block dies with the slot cure (D-13). The value's size token moves to text-mono-small and rides the same container clamp as the label so the pair holds its ratio.

### `design` · D-10 · design

**Defect.** Two actions with zero result state: Copy JSON has no success, failure or pending truth (and swallows rejections), and Reset is destructive, unconfirmed, irreversible, with no compare.

**Mechanism.** VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:101 "Persistent operation state stays with the entity/workspace. A transient flourish ... never carries the only truth" — here there is no truth at all; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md:52 PR-08 is the standing row. The whole interaction grammar (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:96) is select -> tune -> commit; this pane has no commit stage — every drag writes straight into the injected config (:81) and Reset is the only exit. OPTICAL-BENCH-COMPOSITIONS.md:47 requires a `compare` region that does not exist.

**Evidence.**

```
ConfigSliderPane.vue:88-94. Live /#/blob: actions.btns = [{text:"Copy JSON", aria:null, disabled:false},{text:"Reset", aria:null, disabled:false}]; actions.liveRegions finds only the Picker's four channel meters at aria-live="off" — the pane emits no status region at all. `@click="copyAsJson"` on an async function means a writeClipboard rejection is an unhandled promise rejection; every other demo call site marks intent with `void writeClipboard(...)` (ColorPicker.vue:325, ColorInput.vue:222, usePaletteActions.ts:134).
```

**Reproduction.** http://localhost:9000/#/blob -> deny clipboard permission -> click Copy JSON: nothing happens, no error surfaces. Click Reset: 31 values change with no confirmation, announcement or undo.

**Proposed cure.** One durable status region in the action bar owned by the pane (VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:101); Reset becomes Reset + Compare with the canon's destructive-confirmation grammar; copyAsJson gains explicit success/failure arms.

### `design` · D-11 · design

**Defect.** The live readout has neither tabular figures nor reserved width, and infers precision from the value instead of the statically-known step — producing a ~27px live width jitter mid-drag on nearly every slider.

**Mechanism.** Precision derived from the value, not the def. Every BlobPane slider whose range contains an integer (warpAmp 0-1, eccentricity 0-0.5, noiseFreq 0.5-10.0, pulseFreq 0-2, specStrength 0-2, rimPower 1-5, iridescence/sssScale/coreGlow 0-1, pointerAttraction -1..1, stretch 0-1.5, tempo 0.25-2.5, ...) flips its readout between 5 chars and 1 char mid-drag — a ~80% width swing on a 33.9px element. `noiseFreq` step 0.1 renders `0.500`, two digits of false precision on 8 of 31 rows. No `unit` field exists, so `Merge (ms)` smuggles its unit into the label while `Hue Range` (degrees) has none, against VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:124 ("announce label, value, unit").

**Evidence.**

```
Live /#/blob: readout fontVariantNumeric "normal"; "3" = 6.8px, "0.220" = 33.9px, "0.038" = 33.9px; in-place swap "0.220"->"-0.0005" = 32.1 -> 43.7px (delta +11.6px). ConfigSliderPane.vue:84-86 `fmt(v) = Number.isInteger(v) ? String(v) : v.toFixed(3)`. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:78: "Live numbers use tabular figures and reserve their widest legal representation so value changes never reflow the settled chassis."
```

**Reproduction.** node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe2.mjs -> truncation.readoutWidthShift; chD-csp-probe.mjs -> reflow. Visually: drag Warp on /#/blob through 1.00.

**Proposed cure.** `SliderDef` declares `precision` (or derives it once from `step`) and `unit`; the readout gets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums and a min-inline-size reserved from the widest legal string. Both belong on glass-ui's ConfiguratorRow value slot — VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:104 already assigns the axis composition ("label, unit, reserved live value, ...") to the producer.

### `design` · D-12 · design

**Defect.** The declared "ONE RHYTHM SOURCE" container clamp is measurably inert — rendered row height is identical at container widths differing by 2.03x — and it bypasses the producer's real sizing API with utility classes plus a :deep() correction.

**Mechanism.** The row content box (label line + gap-1.5 + 24px track + py-1) always exceeds the clamp, so the clamp never binds and the claim at :208-214 is false — the rhythm is fixed, not container-scaled, contrary to VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:33 law 7. The actual spacing comes from `class="gap-1.5 py-1"` (:142), replacing the producer's ladder, plus a `:deep()` descendant correction that VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:89 says W17 deletes.

**Evidence.**

```
ConfigSliderPane.vue:208-217 `min-block-size: clamp(2rem, 7cqi, 2.625rem)`. Measured (chD-csp-probe.mjs): /atmosphere container 1042px -> resolved 42px, rendered row 60.94px; /blob container 512px -> resolved 35.84px, rendered row 60.94px; /atmosphere 390px container 358px -> 32px, rendered 57.59px. distinctRowHeights = [60.9] on both desktop arms. Separately dataSize: null on every row, while glass-ui.css ships `.configurator-row[data-size=sm|md|lg]` with --configurator-row-gap-* / --configurator-row-py-* plus an @container style(--configurator-size) seam.
```

**Reproduction.** node scratchpad/chD-csp-probe.mjs -> compare desktop-atmosphere.row0 / desktop-blob.row0 / mobile-atmosphere.row0

**Proposed cure.** Delete :215-217 and :142. Pass the producer's `size` (or set --configurator-size once on .config-console) and let the producer's gap/padding ladder own the rhythm. If the rhythm must be container-scaled, that clamp belongs in the producer's --configurator-row-py-* tokens so every consumer inherits one law — which is what "ONE RHYTHM SOURCE" was meant to mean.

### `design` · D-14 · design

**Defect.** The spectral-meniscus material — reserved by the constitution for genuinely chromatic domains (Picker and Gradient only) — is applied unconditionally to 34 geometry, material and time axes.

**Mechanism.** Applying the reserved signature form to non-chromatic domains devalues the signature, and — because the variant blanks .slider-range by recipe — is the direct cause of D-3's missing value read. The record shows it was diagnosed twice and cured neither time: docs/tranches/N/audit/lanes2/U-CONTROLS.md:54 and docs/tranches/N/waves/N.W13.md:28 ("a spectrum slider with no spectrum"); the T.W8 cure at :190-202 fed the variant an ink instead of retiring the variant.

```
ConfigSliderPane.vue:146 `variant="spectrum"` for all 31 BlobPane defs and all 3 AuroraPane defs; live `data-variant="spectrum"` on every .glass-slider in .config-console. VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:7: "the spectral meniscus: a continuous liquid-color rail reserved for genuinely chromatic continuous domains — Picker and Gradient." Domains actually driven: Body Radius, Smooth K, Rim Power, Shininess, Merge (ms), Zones.

**Reproduction.** http://localhost:9000/#/blob; inspect data-variant on any .config-console .glass-slider

### `design` · D-15 · design

**Defect.** Dependent-control state was never designed: at Satellites = 0, five sliders control nothing yet remain fully enabled, focusable and draggable with live readouts.

**Mechanism.** VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md:83: "Selected, failed, pending, withdrawn and disabled states are never color-only. Role, accessible name, state/value and associated error/status are explicit." There is no disabled state to be colour-only with — the state does not exist in the model, so five controls silently lie about their effect.

**Evidence.**

```
BlobPane.vue:59-62 and :111-112 — satelliteCount range 0..4; satelliteRadius, orbitRadius, eccentricity, mergeDuration, emergeDuration all satellite-dependent. ConfigSliderPane.vue:27-33 `SliderDef` has no `disabled` field and the template renders no disabled state; live probe shows aria-disabled: null on every thumb.

**Reproduction.** http://localhost:9000/#/blob at >=1024px -> drag Satellites to 0 -> drag Sat Radius, Orbit Radius, Eccentricity, Merge (ms), Emerge (ms): readouts change, the preview does not, and no control indicates it is inert.

**Proposed cure.** `SliderDef` gains `enabledWhen?: (config) => boolean` (or a declarative `dependsOn` path); the row renders the producer's disabled state with aria-disabled plus an explicit reason. Consumed once by glass-ui's ConfiguratorRow, not hand-rolled per consumer.

### `design` · D-16 · design

**Defect.** The prop contract erases types: both consumers must launder their real config through `as unknown as Record<string, unknown>`, and one spends a 13-line recursive mapped type reconstructing the safety the pane threw away.

**Mechanism.** The pane is generic over "any object addressed by any dot-path string" — the least typeable contract available — and every consumer pays for the generality. It also carries seven jobs in 252 lines with no encapsulation of any (Card shell, scroll host, dot-path resolver, number formatter, clipboard exporter, reset engine, slot host), which is edict 1 (no god modules) and edict 3 (KISS, no contrivance); the widest possible prop type is the symptom.

**Evidence.**

```
ConfigSliderPane.vue:41-52 types config and defaults as Record<string, unknown>. Four double-casts: AuroraPane.vue:111, :113; BlobPane.vue:124, :126. BlobPane.vue:36-48 defines `NumericAtomPath` — a 13-line recursive mapped type with a 24-line comment on two levels of `-?` modifier stripping — solely to restore key safety.
```

**Reproduction.** grep -n "as unknown" demo/scenes/atmosphere/AuroraPane.vue demo/scenes/blob/BlobPane.vue

**Proposed cure.** Make the pane generic over its config: `defineProps<{config: T; sections: SliderSection<T>[]; defaults: T}>()` with SliderDef<T>["key"] a keyof-derived dot-path union. BlobPane.vue:36-48 and all four casts then delete — a net subtraction of ~30 lines. Alternatively the D-8/D-9 split removes the "generic over any object" requirement entirely.

### `design (CHALLENGE-D) — visual truth, state coverage, motion,` · D-3 · design (CHALLENGE-D)

**Defect.** The math introduces a fourth and fifth type family and a rogue 1.21x scale rung outside the closed type matrix.

**Mechanism.** type voice and scale owned by a vendored third-party stylesheet rather than by a token

**Evidence.**

```
Measured computed style (evidence/light-1440.json): `.katex` = `KaTeX_Main, "Times New Roman", serif` at 19.360001px / line-height 23.232002px, inside a 16px/28px Plus Jakarta Sans prose column that also carries 12px Fira Code inline code. 19.360001/16 = 1.21 exactly, from the vendored shorthand `.katex{font:normal 1.21em KaTeX_Main,Times New Roman,serif;line-height:1.2}`. 20 @font-face rules install; 5 faces actually load (KaTeX_Main-Regular, KaTeX_Math-Italic, KaTeX_Size3, KaTeX_Size4 per document.fonts status). VISUAL-CONSTITUTION.md §4: the matrix "is closed across all eighteen compositions... P019's pair is the sole exception"; PROPORTION-AUDIT.md §5.13 names only Fraunces/Plus Jakarta Sans/Fira Code. 1.21x is on neither the glass-ui golden ladder nor the phi ladder (0.382/0.618/1/1.618/2.618rem, foundation.css:458-462).
```

**Reproduction.** node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/Katex/evidence/probe1.mjs — read `rows[].katexFont/katexFontSize` and `inlineSample.parentFontSize`.

**Proposed cure.** Give math a named row in VISUAL-CONSTITUTION §4 and pin it: either math is a SPECIMEN sharing the code fence's jurisdiction (well tone, text-mono-small metric, one named math face) or it is prose-with-symbols (\text{} runs re-mapped to Plus Jakarta Sans, symbol face at an adjacent golden rung). Either way the size comes from a token, not from a vendored `font:` shorthand that also silently resets weight/style/variant/leading.

### `design (CHALLENGE-D) — visual truth, state coverage, motion,` · D-4 · design (CHALLENGE-D)

**Defect.** Selecting and copying a formula yields per-glyph, three-way-duplicated garbage; find-in-page matches every numeral up to 3x per formula.

**Mechanism.** the copy/select/find state was never designed — no decision made about which of three text representations is the payload

**Evidence.**

```
evidence/p5.json — window.getSelection().toString() over one display block returns `f\n(\nt\n)\n=\n{\nt\n3\nt\n>\nϵ...` (every glyph on its own line, then the whole thing again). textContent is a three-way concatenation of the MathML text + the raw LaTeX `<annotation>` + the HTML-layer text; `duplicated: true`. The clean payload exists as annotationText = `f(t) = \begin{cases} \sqrt[3]{t} & t > \epsilon \\ \frac{\kappa\, t + 16}{116} & \text{otherwise} \end{cases}` and is exactly what the reader does not get. Cause: output:"htmlAndMathml" (Katex.vue:41) plus katex.min.css hiding the MathML with `clip-path: inset(50%)`, which removes it from view but not from selection.
```

**Reproduction.** node docs/tranches/V/megatranche/audit/components/Katex/evidence/probe5.mjs; or select any formula on http://localhost:9000/#/ and paste.

**Proposed cure.** Make the copy payload a decision at the root: mark the redundant layers `user-select: none` and let the `<annotation>` LaTeX be the selectable text, or drop to output:"html" and carry accessibility on one authored aria-label. On a page whose purpose is handing the reader formulas, copy is a first-class state.
